item.title: Version 2.2.2026.03.18
item.description:
What's New in 2.2.2026.03.18

Improvements

  • Verification Options sheet — the pre-verification workflow is now clearly organized into a single sheet with two sections: Exclude Folders and Backup Verification.
  • Folder Exclusion — choose specific folders to skip during verification using a folder picker scoped to your session. Supports multi-select. Excluded folders appear as removable chips before you run.
  • Clearer UI — the sheet previously labeled "Backup Verification" has been renamed "Verification Options" to better reflect its purpose.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a build error caused by model fields added in 2.1 not being passed through all initializer call sites.
  • Fixed a Swift compiler timeout in Report Options caused by an overly complex view body.
